column1: # Evidence for the "From ApexYard building itself" figures in the proof
# Each figure row gives the figure, the label that the page prints after it,
# and the recipe that returns the figure. Each recipe is pinned to the cutoff
# or to one commit, so a person can run it again later and get the same value.
# The links on the page go to the same lists without the cutoff, so a visitor
# .github/tests/test-claims.sh reads this file. It fails when the page and this
# file do not agree. To refresh: run each recipe with a new cutoff and a new
# dev_commit, then change this file and both pages in one commit.
# counted_on is the day of the count. cutoff is the end of the counted
# period. dev_commit is the last commit on the dev branch of me2resh/apexyard
# before the cutoff. Columns are separated by one tab.

column3: merged pull requests with an approving review
column4: gh api -X GET search/issues -f q='repo:me2resh/apexyard is:pr is:merged review:approved merged:<2026-11-14T00:00:00Z' --jq .total_count

column3: merged pull requests with a comment that says CHANGES REQUESTED
column4: gh api -X GET search/issues -f q='repo:me2resh/apexyard is:pr is:merged "CHANGES REQUESTED" in:comments merged:<2026-11-14T00:00:00Z' --jq .total_count
